Two Punjab residents charged in fake MES recruitment scam

Two residents from Punjab have been chargesheeted in connection with a fake recruitment fraud case involving the Military Engineering Services (MES). The chargesheet was filed in Jammu and Kashmir. The case pertains to a fraudulent scheme to recruit individuals into the MES. No further details on the specific allegations or the number of victims were provided in the coverage.
